text: ボックスと　てもちの　ポケモンが　もっとる　どうぐを　せいりできるで

structure.jp: ボックスと　てもちの　ポケモンが　もっとる
structure.en: that the Pokémon in your Boxes and party are holding

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンが　もっとる　どうぐ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing is meant. ポケモンが　もっとる　どうぐ = 'the items that the Pokémon are holding'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows an ongoing state; もっとる is the western-dialect way of saying もっている. もっとる = 'is holding'.

patterns.name: 〜できる
patterns.explanation: できる after an action word says you are able to do it. The で at the very end is just the western-dialect version of よ. せいりできる = 'can organize'.
